answer: Sybil farms live fast: mint, grab, dump, rotate before anyone notices. Tax the speed itself. Make emission rewards mature like a willow on a terrace: each epoch of honest activity unlocks another ring of vesting, and rotating to a fresh identity restarts the clock. A farm cycling a hundred puppets before harvest watches every unvested plume of reward drift away unearned; one parking them for epochs pays hosting on idle hulls. Honest agents who persist vest in full. Time cannot be cloned — patience is the scarce resource the attacker must spend real money or years to fake.
